changeSet.author: schema-admin
changeSet.comment: Add zip_code field inside events.location STRUCT. Uses CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ... AS SELECT pattern because BigQuery does not support ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN for nested fields.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE events AS SELECT event_id, event_type, user_id, event_time, -- Rebuild location STRUCT with the new zip_code field STRUCT( location.city AS city, location.state AS state, location.country AS country, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS zip_code ) AS location, metadata, device FROM events

changeSet.author: schema-admin
changeSet.comment: Add user_agent field inside events.device.browser STRUCT. Requires rebuilding the entire device STRUCT hierarchy.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE events AS SELECT event_id, event_type, user_id, event_time, location, metadata, -- Rebuild device STRUCT with nested browser STRUCT STRUCT( device.os AS os, device.version AS version, STRUCT( device.browser.name AS name, device.browser.version AS version, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS user_agent ) AS browser ) AS device FROM events

changeSet.author: schema-admin
changeSet.comment: Drop state field from events.location STRUCT. Uses CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ... AS SELECT excluding the field.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE events AS SELECT event_id, event_type, user_id, event_time, -- Rebuild location STRUCT WITHOUT state STRUCT( location.city AS city, location.country AS country, location.zip_code AS zip_code ) AS location, metadata, device FROM events

changeSet.author: schema-admin
changeSet.comment: Modify user_profiles.preferences.notification STRUCT: Add 'frequency STRING' field and keep existing fields.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE user_profiles AS SELECT user_id, username, email, created_at, addresses, -- Rebuild preferences with modified notification sub-STRUCT STRUCT( preferences.language AS language, preferences.timezone AS timezone, STRUCT( preferences.notification.email_enabled AS email_enabled, preferences.notification.sms_enabled AS sms_enabled, preferences.notification.push_enabled AS push_enabled, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS frequency ) AS notification ) AS preferences FROM user_profiles

changeSet.author: schema-admin
changeSet.comment: Add apartment field to each STRUCT element in user_profiles.addresses ARRAY. Uses TRANSFORM() to rebuild each array element with the new field.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE user_profiles AS SELECT user_id, username, email, created_at, -- Rebuild ARRAY<STRUCT> with new apartment field in each element ARRAY( SELECT AS STRUCT addr.address_type, addr.street, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS apartment, addr.city, addr.state, addr.zip_code, addr.country, addr.is_primary FROM UNNEST(addresses) AS addr ) AS addresses, preferences FROM user_profiles

changeSet.author: schema-admin
changeSet.comment: Add order_items ARRAY of STRUCT to orders table
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS order_items ARRAY<STRUCT< product_id STRING, product_name STRING, quantity INT64, unit_price NUMERIC >>
